# fortisase_security_internal_proxy_policy_clone (Resource)

Internal Proxy Policy Resource API V2 for FortiSASE.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Note: Destroy this resource won't delete the cloned policy.
resource "fortisase_security_internal_proxy_policy_clone" "clone_example" {
  based_on    = "existing_proxy_policy_name" # The policy to clone from
  primary_key = "new_proxy_policy_name"      # The name of the new policy
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `based_on` (String) The policy you what to clone.
- `primary_key` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier, required by Terraform, not configurable.
